source_text: METHOD already thinks in ideas (quote → strongest reading → conditions → look-alikes → verdict). Algorithmic detection still needs: (1) a typed **Idea IR** of claims and support relations, (2) catalog conditions as **predicates over that IR**, (3) a hard split so an LLM may **extract** IR but only the **checker** may issue a flag, justified by predicates + quoted spans.
